title: Choose the RakanSales visual world
question: Which first-viewport direction should govern the homepage comp?

options.label: Sales Tactics Board
options.lineage: team tactics boards and operational playbooks
options.thesis: Every channel becomes one coordinated route into the sales operation.
options.viewport: A dark green operational field routes channel signals into one large conversation workspace.
options.risk: The metaphor fails if later sections become literal sports graphics.

raised.raise: Routing geometry now uses stricter density and alignment.
Active paths feel live without adopting terminal costume.
Every route is continuous and ends at a meaningful product state.
The journey earns one decisive before-to-after reveal.
The headline owns the left field with unapologetic scale.
Identity remains consistent across contexts and modules.

options.label: Signal Routing Exchange
options.thesis: Lead sources enter from everywhere and leave as one traceable revenue flow.
options.viewport: A bright signal map wraps the real pipeline screen from source channels to deals and revenue.
options.risk: Precision could feel technical if the copy and later sections lose warmth.

options.label: Ikeda Data Field
options.thesis: Sales activity becomes a dense field of measurable signals.
options.viewport: A dense signal field frames one product view.
options.case: Loses audience identification and makes the CRM harder to understand quickly.
options.risk: Feels like an art installation instead of software for SME owners.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The sales operation prints itself as a living transcript.
options.viewport: One continuous green sales transcript occupies the screen.
options.case: Loses both axes because it reads as a developer tool and hides visual product proof.
options.kept: Active signals should visibly feel alive.

options.label: Continuous Circuit
options.thesis: Every customer channel forms one uninterrupted sales circuit.
options.viewport: A single luminous path threads through channel, pipeline, and revenue.
options.case: The mechanism maps cleanly, but the material makes a serious sales platform feel decorative.
options.kept: Routes must remain continuous and purposeful.
options.risk: The glow becomes generic AI styling.

options.label: Raku Reveal
options.thesis: Raw sales activity is revealed as a coherent outcome.
options.viewport: A dramatic transformation reveals the finished sales picture.
options.case: The material has no credible relationship to daily Malaysian sales work.
options.kept: One clear transformation should anchor the page story.

options.label: Calavera Broadside
options.thesis: The sales system announces itself with one commanding sheet.
options.viewport: One oversized headline leads a dense two-column product story.
options.case: It communicates urgency, but not the product mechanism or modern software category.
options.risk: Print nostalgia competes with the authentic interface.

options.label: Team Kit System
options.lineage: football crest, number, and home-away identity systems
options.thesis: Every salesperson and module belongs to one recognizable team system.
options.viewport: The product appears as the team crest with modules acting as competition patches.
options.case: It is culturally familiar, but identifies with fandom rather than the SME owner's working day.
options.kept: Identity must remain recognizable across every module and state.
options.risk: A sports metaphor trivializes a serious operational purchase.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar modern SaaS hero, executed cleanly with authentic product proof.
canonCard.viewport: Left-aligned value proposition beside one large conversations screenshot.
canonCard.risk: Clear and polished, but intentionally less ownable than the other directions.
